subject: Post-demo security discovery — request for IR timeline, SOC 2 status, and BCP evidence
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lucy Hoffman <lucy@trailblaze.health>, Ethan Morales <ethan@trailblaze.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo security discovery — request for IR timeline, SOC 2 status, and BCP evidence

Hi Lucy / Ethan —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and clear interest from the product and security teams. Quick recap and the asks we aligned on so we can move the evaluation forward: 

- Recap: demo showed the predictable latency and routing policies you were most interested in; you flagged HIPAA/PHI handling and notification SLA as gating items for procurement.
- Immediate asks for procurement/security review:
  1) Current SOC 2 status (Type I/II, most recent reporting period) and a copy of the SOC 2 report or attestation we can share under NDA.
  2) Completed vendor security questionnaire or short answers to the attached questionnaire. If easier, here is a short form you can fill: https://forms.office.com/r/TrailblazeVendorQuestionnaire
  3) High-level answers on GDPR/HIPAA coverage and whether you have a BAA with downstream vendors.
  4) Incident response / breach notification expectations: what windows do you commit to for initial acknowledgement, full technical root-cause summary, and customer notification? (e.g., ack within X hours, notification within Y hours).
  5) Sample BCP/DR evidence we can provide to our CS/procurement team: redacted runbook, tabletop exercise summary, and RTO/RPO targets.

If you can send the SOC 2 status and the questionnaire by end of week (EOW Friday 2026-09-03) that would keep things moving on our side. We may redact a few operational items before sharing internally.

Thanks — I copied Marissa from GTM so she has context for procurement; if it helps, we can loop Security (Ben) on any technical runbook questions.

Next steps: you send what you have + questionnaire link; I’ll coordinate a short follow-up with procurement to confirm deadlines.

Best,
Kim
Kimberly Park
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Lucy Hoffman <lucy@trailblaze.health>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Morales <ethan@trailblaze.health>, Trailblaze Health Legal <legal@trailblaze.health>
Date: 2026-08-29T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo security discovery — request for IR timeline, SOC 2 status, and BCP evidence

Hi Kim —

Appreciate the concise recap — that matches our notes. Quick responses below and I attached a draft of our vendor form for your intake.

1) SOC 2: Trailblaze completed SOC 2 Type I (security) in 2025; Type II audit in progress with an expected report covering 2026 Q1 — final report targeted for April 2026. We can provide the Type I attestation now; the Type II is available once finalized.

2) Vendor questionnaire: please find a filled draft attached (Trailblaze_Vendor_Risk_Form-draft.pdf). We can also submit answers via your form link if preferred.

3) GDPR / HIPAA: we process PHI for a subset of our customers and maintain BAAs with our downstream PHI processors; we have a named Data Protection Officer. We will provide a short statement of GDPR/HIPAA coverage for your legal team.

4) Incident notification windows: our internal target is initial acknowledgement within 24 hours, preliminary technical update within 72 hours, and a formal customer notification within 7 days depending on severity. Note that for incidents involving confirmed exfiltration of PHI we follow an accelerated cadence and legal will prioritize notification timelines in accordance with applicable law.

5) BCP / DR: we have tabletop exercise summaries and DR runbooks; I attached a high-level overview and the draft vendor form includes fields for RTO/RPO targets.

Posting the attachments: I will upload the full SOC 2 Type I attestation and the BCP overview to a secure file link if you can confirm an NDA or a secure sharing channel.

Let me know if you want us to complete the Office form — happy to do that and loop legal.

Thanks,
Lucy
Lucy Hoffman
Head of Security & Compliance
Trailblaze Health
lucy@trailblaze.health

Ben / Marissa —

Forwarding Trailblaze’s initial reply and draft vendor form. They provided SOC 2 Type I and say Type II is targeted for Q1 2026 (we'll need to confirm exact dates when they share the report). Two asks from procurement/security:

- Can Security prepare a redacted IR runbook and a short breach-notification timeline template we can share (non-sensitive, executive-friendly)?
- Can we provide a short FAQ on our notification windows and example language for customers (e.g., initial ack / technical update / formal notice)? Procurement is requesting example RTO/RPO targets & tabletop summary as well.

Deal: TRB-2026-0047 — Trailblaze Health (us region). If you can turn around the redacted documents by EOD tomorrow morning (2026-08-30), that would keep their procurement timeline intact.

If you prefer, Ben, I can introduce you on a quick call with Lucy to clarify any details.

Thanks — Kim

Subject: Re: Post-demo security discovery — request for IR timeline, SOC 2 status, and BCP evidence

Kim / Marissa / Lucy —

Thanks for the context. Attaching three redacted artifacts we can share with Trailblaze: 

- Redwood_IR_Runbook_v2.1-redacted.pdf — condensed incident runbook suitable for vendor sharing (removes internal contact details and exact escalation phone numbers).
- Breach_Notification_Timeline_Template.csv — simple timeline template showing acknowledgement, triage, containment, analysis, and customer notification windows (we've filled an example row for "moderate severity" incidents).
- BCP_Overview-Summary.pdf — one-page summary of our BCP approach with RTO/RPO guidance and last tabletop exercise date (redacted).

Standards / policy notes:
- Initial acknowledgement: target within 1 hour of detection/notification for incidents impacting multiple customers or critical systems; standard internal acknowledgement target is 4 hours for single-customer tickets.
- Technical update: within 6–24 hours depending on complexity; formal customer notification: within 24–72 hours for most incidents; immediate legal escalation for confirmed PHI exposures to align with regulatory obligations.

Lucy — we are comfortable sharing the attachments above under a standard NDA. I'll also add a short cover note that you can forward to procurement explaining which items were redacted and why. If you need a signed mutual NDA, tell us and we can get legal involved.

Kim — I’ll upload the redacted artifacts to the shared deal folder and drop the HubSpot record link here once complete.

Ben Carter
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
